d: Short, messy, dusty-rose hair with choppy bangs and a side part. Narrow, golden-yellow eyes with a subtle, confident expression on a youthful, mature face. A lean build wearing a white lab coat over a dark charcoal V-neck shirt, layered with a deep burgundy and black sleeveless vest and a silver utility belt. Signature details include a thin grey collar with a small blue "X" on the throat and a rectangular ID badge hanging from a lanyard around the neck.
